{{un|Pokémon League}} }} '''The Final Battle''' (Japanese: '''最終決戦''' ''The Last Battle'') is the 547th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the 23rd chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Crushed Ambition''' (Japanese: '''クラッシュド・アンビション''' ''Crushed Ambition''). ==Plot== {{incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Looker}} returns {{adv|Blake}}'s Pokémon to him. * {{adv|White}} entrusts [[Gigi]] to {{adv|Whitley}} to help her find {{adv|N}}, before sending her onto the [[Plasma Frigate]]. * Whitley encounters [[Hugh]], who apologizes to her and tells he's come to find N as well. * Whitley and Hugh find N and free him. * N agrees to return the {{p|Purrloin}} that was stolen from [[Hugh's sister]] after [[Ghetsis]] is defeated. * In [[Undella Town]], [[Cedric Juniper]] and {{adv|Bianca}} help {{adv|Cheren}} and [[Benga]] to break out of the frozen [[Marine Tube]]. * Cheren's {{p|Snivy}} is revealed to have [[Evolution|evolved]] into {{TP|Cheren|Servine}}. * [[Kelden]] tries to strike down [[Colress]], but its attack instead hits the [[Reveal Glass]], breaking it. * With the Reveal Glass broken, the {{adv|forces of nature}} revert to their Incarnate Formes and are defeated by the {{adv|Swords of Justice}}, along with the [[Shadow Triad]]. * The Forces of Nature escape, freed from [[Team Plasma]]'s control. * Hugh stays to battle the {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s who stole Purrloin, while N and Whitley head to face Ghetsis. * {{adv|N}} and {{adv|Whitley}} find [[Alder]] and {{adv|Looker}}, who have defeated most of [[Ghetsis]]'s Pokémon. * N confronts Ghetsis in a storage room full of [[Poké Ball]]s containing the Pokémon liberated by [[Team Plasma]] and swears to return all the "liberated" Pokémon to their {{pkmn|Trainer}}s. * Looker tries to arrest Ghetsis, but he says he'll rather go down with his dream than be taken captive. * An explosion tears the [[Plasma Frigate]] open, causing all the Poké Balls inside to fall out. * Hugh saves a {{p|Snivy}} from the Team Plasma Grunts he chased. * N tries to save Ghetsis from falling from the Plasma Frigate, but Ghetsis attacks him and calls him a monster. * Ghetsis is saved from his fall by {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Zekrom}}. * {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Kyurem}} separates {{DL|Tao trio (Adventures)|Reshiram}} from itself and leaves. * {{adv|Black}}, {{adv|White}}, and [[Iris]] pursue the Plasma Frigate on Reshiram. * [[Colress]] is revealed to be controlling the {{Shiny|Red}} {{p|Genesect}} through an improved [[Colress Machine]] held by his {{p|Beheeyem}}. * {{adv|Blake}}'s Pokémon destroy the Colress Machine, and Blake defeats Colress with the help of {{p|Victini}}. * Kyurem briefly returns to freeze Colress solid, allowing Looker to take him into custody. * The Plasma Frigate collides with [[N's Castle]], setting it on fire. * The [[Unova first partner Pokémon]] families gather and combine their pledge moves in order to put out the fire. * Ghetsis is taken into custody. * Kyurem freezes over the [[Giant Chasm]] in order to rest peacefully. * Hugh's sister gets her Purrloin back. * Reshiram and Zekrom leave Black and N, respectively.
